name: worker-routing
description: Instruction-only routing for bounded work delegated to native Codex or explicitly configured ACP workers.

interface.shortDescription: Route bounded work to native or ACP workers.
interface.longDescription: Choose when to keep work in the main agent or hand a coherent responsibility to a native Codex worker or an explicitly configured external ACP route, then continue, correct, and accept it with evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Route this task between the main agent and configured workers.
